clue.text: Penalty kick, outside, hems in shot
Addict hosted by the administration
Poem: "To Be the Boss Without Clothing"
For example, kreplach with minor imperfections hiding distasteful lump
Slough off evil creatures
America exposed and disrupted — that's against the law
Cowardly yokel taken in by smallest denomination with time off
Fat, cod, and a bit of oil mashed together?!
Reverse code to read a link for six pairs of Across entries
School's principal cursed crawfishes — they're dangerous when they bite
Oscar winner holds on to suitable branch
Money is power, assuming leadership in banking
Montana city restricted dairy product
Accepts the responsibility of, or has an obligation to, 10 without margins
Cash found in second-rate book
A piece of belittling slander is regressive and stupid
Unexpectedly, hens mingle with the likes of Paul McCartney
Finally, top a road!
Thrown out in onset of devastating blow from one quarter
Go underground in train, protected by moxie
When turning sorrowful, I'm a touchy guy?
Two-thirds of musical piece can make you insensitive
Boredom is unbidden nuisance, essentially
Division's chief illegally screened part of certain letters
Draw out Yale student and most of New Haven, for example
Going either way and ignoring the odds, hatch duck
Crisp demo, with an upgrade included
Rover's owner goes through tuna salad
Proceeding correctly? Be not (ahem) distressed
A sick playwright
Our group, after traveling about in a vehicle
Leopold's flower
Herb's release from jail involving an element of surprise
Watched and listened to a tantrum
Sculptor removing cap for god
